newsitem.title: USA: BioCryst starts oral BCX-34 HIV trial.
newsitem.headline: BioCryst starts oral BCX-34 HIV trial.

text.p: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday that it has started a Phase I feasibility study using an oral formulation of its lead drug, BCX-34, for the treatment of HIV in combination with standard antiretroviral therapy.
According to the company, BCX-34 is a small-molecule drug that modulates the proliferation of T-cells.

Based on preclinical studies, scientists at the University of Alabama at Birmingham and BioCryst theorize that BCX-34 may reduce HIV load in the bloodstream by inhibiting the replication of infected T-cells, the company said.
The study, which is being conducted at the Univeristy of ALabama, is designed to obtain safety, pharmacology and biological data, BioCryst said.
